# Pagination

Page navigation. paginationRange() computes the visible pages and ellipses; the current page has aria-current=page.

## Import

```tsx
import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationEllipsis, PaginationItem, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Pagination } from "@cesuain/ui/pagination";
```

## API

Exports: `Pagination`, `PaginationContent`, `PaginationEllipsis`, `PaginationItem`, `PaginationLink`, `PaginationNext`, `PaginationPrevious`, `paginationRange`.

Types: `PaginationLinkProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `pagination.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
